messages:
jamie: started a canary push of v4.2 to us-east 8m ago. initial smoke green but smokebot reported intermittent 504s on /v1/embed-path.

deploy-bot: Deploy v4.2 -> canaries deployed (8/8). tag: v4.2.0.

smokebot: synth-check: /v1/embed-path returned 2 failures out of 7 samples. p95 = 2.1x baseline. both failures from use-can-04.

noor: checking host telemetry: use-can-04 kv_prefill_backlog=9 and connection errors to kv-store. looks like prefill workers stalled during startup.

jamie: can someone run a targeted probe against use-can-04? posting curl: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://use-can-04.api.redwood/v1/embed-path -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -d '{"text":"probe"}' -w "\n%{http_code} %{time_total}\n"
```

noor: probe results x3 -> 200 0.16, 504 0.35, 200 0.17. intermittent 504s confirmed.

infra-bot: host use-can-04 metrics: kv_prefill_workers=1 backlog=9, prefill_task_errors=0.

noor: hypothesis: prefill concurrency low on that instance; queued prefixes caused head-of-line latency. i'll trigger an on-demand prefill with increased concurrency for embed prefixes.

jamie: go ahead. we'll rerun synth after.

noor: prefill command output: "queued 6 prefixes -> concurrency=4 -> processed 6 -> completed in 14s".

smokebot: rerun synth -> /v1/embed-path 7/7 success from use-can-04. p50/p95 back to normal.

noor: recommendation: continue rollforward but add 20m observation window and pin v4.2 to canaries for 8h. also enable temporary alert: embed-route p99 and kv_prefill_backlog > 5 for 8h. document mitigation step in ops-notes.

jamie: +1. i'll update internal release notes: "v4.2.0 - gradual. Note: transient kv prefill backlog observed on canary use-can-04 causing intermittent 504s to /v1/embed-path; mitigation: targeted prefill with higher concurrency executed and verification passed. Rollout resumed with 20m observation and 8h canary pin."

noor: filing follow-up INFRA-6801 to raise default prefill concurrency and add startup visibility metrics.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollforward to remainder of us-east in 20m from 6160001294.

jamie: oncall checklist during observation: 1) confirm p99 < baseline 2) confirm kv_prefill_backlog drains on new hosts 3) if error rate >4% over 5m, abort and pin.

noor: i'll watch the channel for the window. ping if alert triggers.

jamie: thanks all, closing thread after observation window if stable. :thumbsup:
